shared_elements: row of three arch-shaped/H-like signs across the top register
horizontal band with hanging triangles / zigzag fringe
quadruped in profile with open jaws (feline or canid) at left
second quadruped in profile facing it at right
small crouching human-like or animal figure below centre
large bird in profile with prominent beak at lower left
elongated snake-like body with ribbed/chevron infill in lower register
vertical stacked registers separated by a projecting ledge
justification: Both surfaces show the identical composition: three arched signs above a fringed horizontal band, a pair of confronted open-jawed quadrupeds flanking a disc and a small crouching figure, and below a ledge a ribbed serpentine body with a large beaked bird at lower left. The only differences are of viewpoint, cleaning and edge breakage, not of depicted content — these are evidently the same carved scene.
